title: Microsoft 365 admin center: access policies for Organizational Data custom attributes
summary: The briefing passes: the roadmap facts, Staging restriction, licensing and delegate-access behaviour are supported. The admin route needs its remaining editor steps and a note about differing Microsoft navigation guidance; the assertion that agent capabilities are unchanged is not documented.

claims.where: Scope; controls[0].note; Governance controls; Governance guidance: After rollout
claims.claim: Global Administrator and Organizational Data Source Administrator are the roles that create and manage Organizational Data access policies centrally.
claims.quote: The Microsoft 365 Global Administrator or the Organizational Data Source Administrator create and manage these policies centrally in Microsoft 365 Organizational Data Service.

claims.claim: The printed Microsoft 365 admin center route reaches Edit access policies, where audiences, population and delegation are configured.
claims.quote: Under the Organization-wide access policy section, select Edit access policies. ... To edit one of the configurable access policies, select the access policy from the list, then select Edit access policy.
claims.fix: Use 'Settings > Setup > Migration and Imports > tools to migrate or import data > Microsoft 365 Organizational Data Service > Settings > Organization-wide access policy > Edit access policies > Configure access policies > policy > Edit access policy'. Note that Users, Population group and Allow users to delegate access are configured there. Also note that the cited get-started page gives a different migration route: 'Setup > Migration resources > Migrate to the cloud with confidence > Explore migration & import tools > Microsoft 365 Organizational Data Service' (https://learn.microsoft.com/microsoft-365-apps/org-data-service/get-started#step-3-access-microsoft-365-organizational-data-service).

claims.claim: The prepare action rating fits this low-risk, low-cost new control.
claims.quote: action: "prepare"; risk: "low"; cost: "low"; summary: "Launched; review before you share attributes." The standard defines review for a new control and reserves prepare for a new control closing high exposure.
claims.fix: Set action to 'review': this is a launched new control rated low in risk and cost, with review needed before an administrator chooses to share attributes.
